title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Mineral Sample Ledger. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Mineral Sample Ledger
options.lineage: quarry sample books and stone merchant ledgers
options.thesis: FISHEYE presents as a mineral sample ledger: projects are specimens on warm stone paper; type is inventory caption, never decoration.
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge villa plate on warm bone ground; FISHEYE as inventory mark top-left; one offer line and one solid CTA in a thin bottom caption rail, no stats, no gradient veil.
options.risk: Can feel sparse if plates are timid; luxury here is scale and silence, not ornament.

raised.raise: Exactly four mineral tones lock the system, no fifth marketing accent.
One continuous sheet across the site, never broken into floating card islands.
Charged emptiness between plates is as intentional as the photograph (ma).
Process reads as numbered field notes on the ledger, not feature cards.

options.label: Architectural Monograph
options.thesis: The studio site is a bound architectural monograph, one photograph owns the spread; type is caption.
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge Marbella villa plate; FISHEYE title-block top-left; offer and CTA in bottom caption rail.
options.risk: Also the direction most luxury-architecture runs land on, familiar and effective.

options.label: Tokonoma Ma
options.thesis: Each project hangs in a pale alcove; asymmetry and empty plaster do the selling.
options.viewport: Off-center plate with large charged empty field; primary line is the photograph; CTA as a quiet stem at the base.
options.case: Holds audience identification on luxury restraint; loses narrowly on product clarity for a photo-led Marbella portfolio.
options.risk: Ma can read as unfinished if emptiness is not rigorously composed.

options.label: Dungeon Tape J-Card
options.case: Fuses poorly: villa owners do not identify with underground tape culture.
options.kept: Single ink-weight discipline, donated as the four-tone lock raise.

options.label: Game Boy Field
options.case: Loses both axes for luxury residential interiors.
options.kept: Strict limited-palette courage, donated as the four-tone mineral lock.

options.label: Technical Zine
options.case: Clarity of teaching is real; the marker vernacular fights premium architecture.
options.kept: Process as numbered teaching notes, donated to the ledger field-notes raise.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.case: Instrument clarity does not map to Marbella villa photography.
options.kept: Everything measured against a modular grid.

options.label: Hand-Bent Neon
options.case: Spectacle fights the brief’s mineral restraint.
options.kept: Continuous single-stroke commitment, donated as continuous-sheet raise.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What luxury architecture portfolios ship: quiet grid, large photography, understated type, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Centered hero photograph, studio name, short offer, primary CTA, the arrangement visitors expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from peer studios by design.
